production_method: YuNet face detector + SFace face recognizer (OpenCV cv2.FaceDetectorYN / cv2.FaceRecognizerSF); score = cosine similarity of the two SFace embeddings

input.image: RGB (uint8 0-255 or float 0-1), any size; converted to BGR inside ekyc.face

decision.chosen_on: LFW development train pairs (2200): highest TAR with FAR <= 1%
decision.policy: score < threshold (0.2597): mismatch; threshold-0.556: needs review; >= 0.556: match. 0.556 = the threshold that kept FAR <= 1 % on synthetic ID-portrait pairs (Phase 4 notebook, information only there), adopted as the review boundary in CLAUDE.md; no face found: retake.

no_face_found: no score: ask for a new photo or route to manual review (never accept)

siamese_showcase.input: two RGB faces, resized with padding to 128x128, pixels 0-255 (the model rescales them)
siamese_showcase.chosen_on: 332 held-out LFW train pairs (people not used for training)

scope: threshold from LFW (celebrity photos); re-check on real selfie-ID pairs before production use
